Inbound SMB lead — ecommerce recommendation engine + chat widget. Self-serve initially; wants hosted API but cost-conscious. Current behaviour observed in sample logs: avg tokens per chat ~420 (system + user + assistant), ~60% is system/preamble; 2–3 API calls per customer session. Key asks: batching (combine small queries into single multi-prompt calls), prefix caching for product catalog context, and prompt compression (truncate/encode repeated context). Asked for token audit to show hot spots.

Model preference: open models OK if cost-effective, otherwise Redwood verified small variants. Routing/fallback: want automatic cheaper fallback when load spikes. Security: SOC2 + basic audit logs required; retention policy: 30 days but legal asked about longer retention for certain records — blocker. Wants example Node SDK snippet to implement caching/batching.

Next steps (AE/SE): send token-usage audit template, sample batching + caching config for hosted_api, and a short playbook (1–2 page) showing expected cost impact.
